about.intro:
I'm a designer and 3D modeler. For the past two and a half years I've been the lead designer at an anime merchandising company, designing licensed apparel and goods for series including Monogatari, Steins;Gate and Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt.

I've also freelanced for several years with a variety of musical artists, doing cover art, merchandise and promotional graphics.

Outside of those roles I design logos, websites and typefaces, and I model and sculpt in 3D. I work fluently in almost all major design software, so I can take a project from first sketch to a finished print file, web page or 3D asset without handing it off.

Game design is the work I'm most invested in. I'm currently building my own game. When it's released, it will be the first and largest section of this portfolio.
